# Autonomous momentum logic: constructed clock, failed hardware transfer

3 November 2026. Independent route, not an extension of the chiral-fermion work. **No civilisation-changing computing capability or same-resource advantage was obtained.** This pass built the central clock/gate mechanism rather than substituting a bibliography. It isolates an exact mathematical repair and the physical interaction that remains unearned. Novelty is not established.

## Intended capability and contract

The desired outcome was sustained reliable reversible classical computation at useful throughput with less TOTAL energy per useful operation than the strongest energy-recovery implementation at the SAME temperature, fabrication/interaction capabilities, device count, reliability, and rate. Below-Landauer work for a non-erasing gate is already allowed and is not the target breakthrough. Count preparation, clock distribution and stabilization, finite damping, refrigeration, read/write, fanout, reset and error-correction entropy. A single ideal NOT does not supply universal composable hardware.

The attempted missing operation was replacing an externally timed momentum-logic pulse by a finite-energy autonomous clock, while explicitly retaining backreaction of the gate on that clock. The main exact constructions are classical Hamiltonian models. No quantum computing advantage is claimed.

## Decisive primary source and present Astra check

Ray, Boyd, Wimsatt and Crutchfield, Physical Review Research 3,023164 (2021), https://journals.aps.org/prresearch/pdf/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.3.023164, pp.2–3, constructs NOT from a half-period harmonic rotation and Fredkin from commensurate normal-mode rotations. Its ideal pulse changes potentials and thermal coupling at externally specified times. The finite-damping simulation is not a physical account of a self-contained controller. This is the precise transfer attempted here; the source's logical construction itself is not new work by us.

A bounded current-record search located U1299-hamiltonian-clock-and-tube-constraint; its current packet and exact governing PROOF.md are saved. # Physical attempt: guiding-center clock and a Coulomb target

This follows the parent's constructive suggestion after the finite-reserve action-angle clock was built. **It advances the physical mechanism beyond an arbitrary angle-only potential, but does not earn that potential, a complete gate, or an advantage over energy-recovery logic.**

## What a magnetic clock genuinely changes

For a charge in a strong perpendicular B field, guiding-center coordinates are conjugate up to orientation, with |{X,Y}|=1/|qB|. Thus J=|qB|R²/2 and theta are an action-angle pair made from two physical spatial coordinates. A quadratic positive radial potential gives linear H_clock=omega J at leading guiding-center order. This evades the earlier restriction to one natural coordinate-only oscillator coupling: spatial angular patterning can act on the canonical clock angle.

But an ordinary Penning trap is NOT automatically this positive-energy clock. Axial electrostatic confinement entails radial anti-confinement; its slow magnetron mode has negative energy, and dissipation increases its radius. Positive radial confinement needs an independently paid axial/2D mechanism. An ideal planar constraint was supplied in the tests below, not derived from electrodes.

For a positively confined planar massive charge, the exact quadratic radial frequencies are

    Omega_s=(sqrt(omega_c²+4omega_0²)-omega_c)/2,
    Omega_f=(sqrt(omega_c²+4omega_0²)+omega_c)/2.

Finite-cyclotron corrections depend on Omega_s/omega_c; thermal gyroradius smears an angular harmonic n by order n² rho_L²/R². A classical thermal estimate is rho_L²~kT/(m omega_c²), up to the convention for mean-square radius. Very strong B is a resource, and quantum/cryogenic regimes need their actual occupation law. No thermal ensemble or refrigeration bill was simulated here.

Primary checks: Imperial's Penning-trap description https://www.imperial.ac.uk/ion-trapping/research/current-research-topics/penning-trap/; the primary experiment https://link.springer.com/article/10.1140/epjti/s40485-017-0039-4 explicitly discusses negative magnetron energy and collisional radial growth. These support the confinement caveat, not the new gate.
